The '''C3-KR Probe Droid''' was a model of small [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The C3-KR Probe Droid was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with patch 4.7.3 and is available from the Scavenger Alliance Pack.
